crossRefs.note: Samuel said, “Gather all Israel to Mizpah, and I will pray to Yahweh for you.”
They gathered together to Mizpah, and drew water, and poured it out before Yahweh, and fasted on that day, and said…
Then all the children of Israel went out, and the congregation was assembled as one man, from Dan even to Beersheba…

people.name: Mizpah
people.line: A city in Benjamin; a place of gathering and judgment

people.name: Samuel
people.line: Prophet and last judge of Israel before the kings
